From 8cf699ec849f4ca1413cea01289bd7d37dbcc626 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2017 08:39:24 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] mlx4: do not call napi_schedule() without care

Disable BH around the call to napi_schedule() to avoid following warning

[   52.095499] NOHZ: local_softirq_pending 08
[   52.421291] NOHZ: local_softirq_pending 08
[   52.608313] NOHZ: local_softirq_pending 08

Fixes: 8d59de8f7bb3 ("net/mlx4_en: Process all completions in RX rings after port goes up")
Signed-off-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Cc: Erez Shitrit <erezsh@mellanox.com>
Cc: Eugenia Emantayev <eugenia@mellanox.com>
Cc: Tariq Toukan <tariqt@mellanox.com>
Acked-by: Tariq Toukan <tariqt@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_netdev.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_netdev.c
index 4910d9af1933..761f8b12399c 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_netdev.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_netdev.c
@@ -1748,8 +1748,11 @@ int mlx4_en_start_port(struct net_device *dev)
 	/* Process all completions if exist to prevent
 	 * the queues freezing if they are full
 	 */
-	for (i = 0; i < priv->rx_ring_num; i++)
+	for (i = 0; i < priv->rx_ring_num; i++) {
+		local_bh_disable();
 		napi_schedule(&priv->rx_cq[i]->napi);
+		local_bh_enable();
+	}
 
 	netif_tx_start_all_queues(dev);
 	netif_device_attach(dev);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_netdev.c`**
- The loop that processes RX rings has been modified to include `local_bh_disable()` and `local_bh_enable()` calls around the `napi_schedule()` function.
- This change ensures that the bottom halves (BH) are disabled while scheduling the NAPI (New API) context, which prevents potential warnings related to local softirq pending.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a specific warning that occurs when `napi_schedule()` is called without disabling bottom halves, which can lead to issues in the network driver. 
- The patch is a fix for a previous commit (identified by the hash `8d59de8f7bb3`), which introduced the processing of all completions in RX rings after the port goes up. The new changes ensure that this processing is done safely, thereby improving the stability of the driver.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
napi_schedule(&priv->rx_cq[i]->napi);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because `napi_schedule()` is called without disabling bottom halves (BH). This can lead to concurrent execution of softirq handlers while scheduling NAPI, resulting in warnings about local softirq pending and potential race conditions in packet processing.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
local_bh_disable();
napi_schedule(&priv->rx_cq[i]->napi);
local_bh_enable();
```
Reason:
The fix involves wrapping the call to `napi_schedule()` with `local_bh_disable()` and `local_bh_enable()`. This ensures that bottom halves are disabled during the scheduling of NAPI, preventing concurrent execution of softirq handlers and eliminating the warnings about local softirq pending.
